mapper.sql: select hr.relation_id, hr.honor_id, hr.ref_type, hr.ref_id, hr.del_flag, hr.create_by, hr.create_time, hr.update_by, hr.update_time, hr.remark, hr.role_desc, hr.contribution_desc, case hr.ref_type when 'PROJECT' then concat(concat(p.project_no, ' '), p.project_name) when 'RESEARCHER' then su.nick_name when 'UNIT' then cu.unit_name else null end as ref_name from honor_relation hr left join project p on hr.ref_type = 'PROJECT' and hr.ref_id = p.project_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user su on hr.ref_type = 'RESEARCHER' and hr.ref_id = su.user_id left join cooperative_unit cu on hr.ref_type = 'UNIT' and hr.ref_id = cu.unit_id and cu.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where hr.del_flag = '0' and hr.honor_id = #{honorId} order by hr.relation_id asc
mapper.update: update honor_relation set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where relation_id = #{relationId} and del_flag = '0'
update honor_relation set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where honor_id = #{honorId} and del_flag = '0'
